sn36.11:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn36.11:1.2: idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
sn36.11:1.4: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
sn36.11:1.8: kinnu kho etaṃ bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ;
sn36.11:2.2: tisso imā bhikkhu vedanā vuttā mayā.
sn36.11:2.3: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā,
sn36.11:2.7: taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhārānaññeva aniccataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
sn36.11:2.9: taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhārānaññeva khayadhammataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ: yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhasminti. taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhārānaññeva
sn36.11:2.10: vayadhammataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ: yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhasminti. taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhārānaññeva
sn36.11:2.11: virāgadhammataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ: yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhasminti. taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhārānaññeva
sn36.11:2.12: nirodhadhammataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ: yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhasminti. taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhārānaññeva
sn36.11:2.15: atha kho pana bhikkhu mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ nirodho akkhāto.
sn36.11:2.16: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā niruddhā hoti.
sn36.11:2.17: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā niruddhā honti.
sn36.11:2.18: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti niruddhā hoti.
sn36.11:2.19: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā niruddhā honti.
sn36.11:2.24: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti.
sn36.11:2.25: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo niruddho hoti, doso niruddho hoti, moho niruddho hoti.
sn36.11:2.26: atha kho pana bhikkhu mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto.
sn36.11:2.27: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā vūpasantā hoti.
sn36.11:2.28: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā vūpasantā honti, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti vūpasantā hoti, catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā vūpasantā honti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpannassa rūpasaññā vūpasantā hoti, viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpannassa ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā vūpasantā hoti, ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpannassa viññāṇañcāyatanasaññā vūpasantā hoti, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpannassa ākiñcaññāyatanasaññā vūpasantā hoti,
sn36.11:2.29: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca vūpasantā honti.
sn36.11:2.30: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo vūpasanto hoti, doso vūpasanto hoti, moho vūpasanto hoti.
sn36.11:2.32: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā paṭippassaddhā hoti.
sn36.11:2.33: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā paṭippassaddhā honti.
sn36.11:2.34: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti paṭippassaddhā hoti.
sn36.11:2.35: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā paṭippassaddhā honti.
sn36.11:2.36: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca paṭippassaddhā honti.
sn36.11:2.37: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo paṭippassaddho hoti, doso paṭippassaddho hoti, moho paṭippassaddho hotīti.
